title: BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStats
description: Timing statistics for a session thread.

duration_seconds.description: Elapsed time since thread creation in seconds. For archived threads, frozen at the final update.

startup_seconds.description: Time in seconds for the thread to begin running. Zero for child threads, which start immediately.

active_seconds.description: Cumulative time in seconds the thread spent actively running. Excludes idle time.
